notes.title: Build 1.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Hellenore pick up sounds now have an audio manager
[*]Made materials' vertex wobble in Hellenore intro cutscene consistent so the break between the wall and floor is no longer there.
[*]Fixed NSA exhibit text that was cut off.
[*]Fixed NSA menu bug where the copyright years would change when starting a new game.
[*]Realigned NSA basement tiles that were offset causing the tiniest black line to appear.
[*]Added description to Portrait of wife in Doll Display Room in NSA.
[*]Due to sensitive nature, added explicit note in 'Against The Night' to clarify a player doesn't need to read it if they're not comfortable with subject matter.
[*]Added additional blood spot in NSA main hall to help guide players towards kitchen.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added extra hints for painting puzzle in No Strings Attached
[*] Added audio managers where missing in Become Prey, Become Prey 2, & KILLDEATH Again
[*] Fixed Become Prey 2 achievement "I Can Finally Retire", where gems received through damage didn't count towards total.
[*] Fixed Flashlight material in Become Prey so it is no longer invisible.
[*] Condensed audio sources in KILLDEATH Again for better performance.
[*] Added Arrows To KILLDEATH's menu to suggest to a player they can change the difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added option for V Sync. While V Sync is on, Refresh Rate is locked to monitor's refresh rate.
[*] Resolution now changes with one click instead of several.
[*] Updated KILLDEATH's directional inputs from Value to Pass Through to make them less 'sticky'
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Game now checks 100% progress when exiting back to the collection instead of only on launch.
[*] Listen to all commentaries achievement was triggering prematurely, attempted to fix that.
[/list]
